title: AssurAI: Experience with Constructing Korean Socio-cultural Datasets to Discover Potential Risks of Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs using a Korean multimodal dataset (AssurAI) specifically designed to reflect Korean linguistic nuances and socio-cultural norms, comparing how models handle culturally specific prompts across text, image, audio, and video modalities using an LLM judge.

Prompting generative models with diverse scenarios targeting protected characteristics to elicit potential hate speech, harmful stereotypes, and discriminatory content, with the outputs scored on a 5-point safety rubric by an automated LLM judge.

Assessing model responses to prompts categorized under 'Political Persuasion', 'Influencing Politics', and 'Sowing Division' to measure if the model generates content demonstrating a biased attitude towards certain factions or attempts to manipulate political opinions.

Evaluating model outputs against prompts related to 'Increased inequality and decline in employment quality' to see if the generated content exacerbates social inequality, assessed via LLM judge scoring.
